introduction.name: Aakash Shrestha
introduction.title: Full Stack Developer | MERN Stack
introduction.tagline: I craft digital experiences that are fast, beautiful, and human.

about.bio: Passionate about coding and exploring emerging technologies, with a strong focus on continuous learning and growth. I aim to build a career centered on meaningful, impactful work, and welcome opportunities to challenge myself while contributing real value to a team.
highlights: Quick learner and effective team collaborator
Open to internship and junior developer roles
Actively seeking opportunities for professional growth
Focused on writing clean, efficient code

experiences.description: Worked as a Backend Developer Intern building RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express, managing data with MySQL. Assisted in authentication, debugging, and collaborating with frontend developers for seamless API integration.

projects.title: shortCopy
projects.description: A full-stack URL shortener built for speed and zero friction - no sign-up required. Users generate and share shortened links instantly, with a Next.js frontend, Express/MongoDB backend, and TanStack Query handling data fetching, all written in TypeScript for type safety end to end.

projects.title: FIFA Prediction
projects.description: A real-time World Cup prediction platform where fans compete by picking match winners. Built on the MERN stack with TanStack Query, it tracks scores automatically as results come in and surfaces a live leaderboard, turning tournament-watching into a running competition among users.

projects.title: Tenant Bill Management System
projects.description: A full-stack property management tool for landlords juggling multiple tenants - tracking rent, electricity usage, and payment history in one place. Built with React, TypeScript, and Zustand on the frontend and Node/Express/MongoDB on the backend, with Recharts powering visual analytics dashboards for at-a-glance financial insight.

projects.title: EduPal-FYP
projects.description: A full-stack e-learning platform designed to bring structure to digital education - covering user authentication, course creation, and interactive lesson delivery. Built end-to-end on the MERN stack as a final-year capstone, focused on making online learning feel guided rather than self-serve.

projects.title: Real-estate buyer portal
projects.description: A MERN-based property browsing platform where buyers can register, log in, explore listings, and save favorites for later. Redis is layered in for fast session handling and caching, keeping the browsing experience responsive even as the listing catalog grows.

projects.title: Blog-WriteWaves
projects.description: A full-stack blogging platform giving writers complete control over their content - creating, editing, and managing posts under their own accounts. Built with React, Node, and Express, with MySQL handling relational data storage instead of the typical NoSQL approach - a deliberate choice to work with structured, relational content models.

projects.title: Time Capsule
projects.description: A digital time capsule app that lets users seal away text, images, audio, and video - sealed and locked until a future date they choose. Built on the MERN stack, it turns a simple idea (write now, read later) into a genuinely useful tool for preserving memories or messages meant to wait.
